output_list.reason: The contract does not check if the call to msg.sender.transfer(msg.value) is successful before transferring the balance to the owner. This could allow the owner to reenter the contract and receive more ether than intended.

The stopGame function is only callable by the owner, but it does not check if the sender is the owner before transferring the balance to the owner. This could allow anyone to stop the game and receive the balance.
